name: smwgraphics-mega-man-the-wily-wars-ice-man
title: Mega Man: The Wily Wars - Ice Man
description:
For you Ice Man fans, I uploaded the tileset released at Summer C3 2025.
I did fix some map16 issues.
Also, the remaining BG tiles are in ExGFX696, which goes to BG3. There's also ExGFX667, which is the same, but no BG tiles. Very useful if you want a different BG for the Ice Man FG.
Enjoy! No credit needed.
